svg.title: Computing f_U by one upward sweep
svg.desc: An animation of the sweep that computes f_U for the box of Figure 1 of the paper, on a path with 14 vertices. A threshold t rises from 0 to 10 and stops at every value where something happens. At t = 1: Vertices 1 and 8 enter. No vertex has u(v) ≤ t yet, so nothing is assigned. At t = 2: u(1) ≤ 2 activates the component {1}: f_U(1) = 2, and a bar is born. At t = 3: Vertex 2 joins the active component. u(8) ≤ 3 activates {7, 8}: a second bar. At t = 4: Vertices 0 and 9 join active components; {12, 13} is still inactive. At t = 5: u(4) ≤ 5 activates {4, 5}: a third bar is born. At t = 6: Vertex 3 merges {4, 5} into an older component, so [5, 6) ends. Vertex 10 joins {11, 12, 13} to an active component: f_U = 6 on all four. At t = 7: Vertex 6 merges the last two components, so the younger bar, [3, 7), ends. At t = 10: Every vertex has its value. Bar_0(f_U) = Bar_0(u ≥ ℓ), bar for bar (Theorem 5). On the right the degree-0 barcode of f_U grows with t: [2, inf), [3, 7) and [5, 6).

g.text: The threshold t rises. A vertex enters K[ℓ ≤ t] once t ≥ ℓ(v).
Vertices 1 and 8 enter. No vertex has u(v) ≤ t yet, so nothing is assigned.
u(1) ≤ 2 activates the component {1}: fU(1) = 2, and a bar is born.
Vertex 2 joins the active component. u(8) ≤ 3 activates {7, 8}: a second bar.
Vertices 0 and 9 join active components; {12, 13} is still inactive.
u(4) ≤ 5 activates {4, 5}: a third bar is born.
Vertex 3 merges {4, 5} into an older component, so [5, 6) ends. Vertex 10 joins {11, 12, 13} to an active
Vertex 6 merges the last two components, so the younger bar, [3, 7), ends.
Every vertex has its value. Bar0(fU) = Bar0(u ≥ ℓ), bar for bar (Theorem 5).
